# Governance

karako-cdn is maintained by [Karako Systems](https://karakosystems.com).

## Decisions

Maintainers review and merge pull requests, and have the final say on
scope. Discussion happens in issues and pull requests, in public.

The project stays deliberately small: a single binary, zero
dependencies in the server module, and a narrow feature set. A proposal
that grows the surface needs a clear use case that the current design
cannot cover.

## Releases

release-please turns conventional commits into versions, the changelog
and a GitHub release. Every release publishes a multi-arch image to
GHCR. Breaking changes only ship in a major version.
